tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang gsal byed dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// bka' babs dgu ldan// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dang rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma nyams su blang bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bdun yan chad ci rigs pa brjod la/ de nas sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i sems bskyed lan gsum byas la/ de nas rang skad cig gis tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la thal mo sbyar te/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res nad rnams kun las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byung chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyod par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces pas yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas la/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu zhes sogs kyis tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid du mos la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems tām̐ yig las utpal dkar po'i yu ba tām̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus tām̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ dbu skra li ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba la rgyab gtad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa'i skur bsgoms la/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ āryā tā re arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ de ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas pa la mchod pa ni/ oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra shabda tītstsha swā hā/ de nas oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta sogs brjod pas rol mo'ang 'bul lo// de nas bstod pa ni/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res nad rnams kun las sgrol// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas pa// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// utpal 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus 'chang zhing*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la tā la sogs pa'i yi ge brgyad/ lte bar tām̐ gyi mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs dang lte ba'i bar du/ bdag gi tshe 'phel bar gyur cig ces pas bskor bar dmigs la/ yig 'bru de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yon tan spyan drangs tām̐ la thim par mos la ngag tu/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci nus bzlas la/ mjug tu bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bzlas pa'i gong ltar mchod bstod bsdus pa ci rigs pa zhig byas la/ bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab ste spyod lam la 'jug go /tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa las dang po pas nyams su blang bde ba 'di ni/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i gsung las byon pa zin bris su bris pa 'dis dge zhing tshe 'phel bar gyur cig/ ༈ /bla ma dang tshe sbyin ma'i rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang bar byed par 'dod pas don tshan rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ mdun du ras la sogs pa gzhi bzang po'i steng du/ 'khar ba la sogs pa'i maṇḍal gyi steng du tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mtha' mar g.yas skor du byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog nas bzung ste chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod zhal zas kyi bar bsham/ shar du gtor ma gcig kyang bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ bum par dri bzang po'i chu bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba dang bcas pa bshams la/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hā zhes pa nas/ shabda swā hā zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum brjod pa'i rol mos byin dbab/

de nas skyabs su 'gro ba nas bzung ste bzlas pa'i rjes su mchod bstod bya ba'i bar thams cad sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ de nas bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang po'i chus gang ba'i steng du rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa bzhag la/ de nyid a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las utpa la tām̐ gyis mtshan pa zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa'i bar thams cad sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas sngags gyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song*/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar phog de'i ba spu'i bu ga nas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun mar khra la la byung bum pa'i nang thams cad gang bar mos la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā// zhes pa brgya rtsa gcig bzlas la gong ltar mchod bstod bya zhing 'dod don gsol btab byas la/ badzra muḥs bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i chur gyur byas la/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod do// de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ maṇḍal a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las utpa la dkar po'i yu bar tām̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/

tshur 'dus tām̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas utpa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ dbu skra li ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba la rgyab gtad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa'i skur bsgoms la de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral pa'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ces pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā zhes pa nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā be sha aḥzhes brjod pas dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

dbang gi lha spyan drang ba dang*/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis de la mchod pa dang*/ khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol ces pas gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas mdun gyi mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod// oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi 'don pa bsgyur la/ mchod yon gyi gnas su/ me tog ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ bdug spos ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ dhūm̐ paṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ snang gsal ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā/ dri mchog ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ gandhaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhal zas ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ nai wi dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sil snyan ji snyed yod pa rnams dang*/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pas rol mo 'bul dharmā ra ṇi ta brjod/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing*/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// zhes sogs tshigs bcad lngas bstod/ de nas mdun gyi gtor ma chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par gyur/ ces brjod la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharm+mā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu gtor ma la zugs te gsol bas mnyes par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ āryā tā re arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ces pas 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ slar yang gtor ma de nyid oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ sngar gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra sogs btags la lan gsum gyis dbul/ da sha dika lo ka pā la arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod ces brjod do// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga yan gang rung*/ khrus byas nas gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog dgram bsdu byas/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag bskyed bum bskyed mdun bskyed gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar dgos pa thams cad da res nas kyi gnas skabs su grub par byas nas/ slob ma la bya ba la rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal cig phul zhig byas la/ maṇḍal 'bul du bcug phul tshar ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i phung po rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs// khyod zhabs padmo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis// blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod// ces pa lan gsum gyi bar rjes zlos byed du bcug

de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags mar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bzhugs pa'i spyan snga nas yar rgyun bshags mdzad pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum rjes zlos byed du bcug de nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod byas la/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa khyed rang gi sku lus la phog pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams kyi bar du gcod pa dang rnam smin gyi sha rus dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo tām̐ las utpa la tām̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus tām̐ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgom du bcug la/ slob dpon la'ang khyed rang gis bsgoms pa ltar gyi 'phags ma sgrol ma dngos yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de dag thams cad kyi thugs ka dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang bcas pa rnams nas/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad khengs nas byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod la slob ma gu gul gyis bdug slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil zhing ngag tu/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re sogs tshar gsum brjod/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung sbyin pa ni/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams gnyis ka sgrol ma dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa re re/ de'i lte bar tām̐ dkar po re bsam pa'i slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i tām̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i tām̐ gyi mdun du oṃ/ rgyab tu hā/ rtsibs brgyad kyi mdun nas g.yas skor du tā la sogs pa'i yi ge brgyad/ lte ba dang rtsibs kyi bar du ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes pa byung bar mos la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug de nas slob dpon la me tog phul la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum bya/ de nas me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas blugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ dngos su slob dpon gyis slob ma la me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la tshe sbyin ma'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs shing khyad par dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

dbang bskur gyi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang ba thogs te ngag tu/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus khyed rang gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod byas la dngos su slob dpon gyis bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ bum pa'i chu'ang sbyin/ de nas dbang gi lha khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par bya/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod do// de ni rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi yin la/ mjug gi cho ga la khrus bya ba ni/ dngos su slob ma bum chus bkru la ngag tu/ oṃ tā re sogs kyi sngags tshar gcig brjod/ mjug tu khyed rang rnams kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du thams cad kyi mjug tu shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa btags la/ nad thams cad shāntiṃ= gdon thams cad= rims thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad= 'khon dang grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad= byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad= bkra mi shis pa thams cad= mtshan mo nag mo dang dus kyi zhags pa dang gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad= bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad= rgyal po dang the'u rang gi gnod pa thams cad= btsan dang rmu'i gnod pa thams cad= klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru'o// byabs pa ni/

bum chu cung zad re khar 'dzin du bcug la/ khyed rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad slob dpon gyis rma bya'i sgros byabs pas kha'i chu la 'dus pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob dpon gyis ku sha'i sgro dang bcas pas byabs pa'i tshul bya zhing ngag tu sngags lan gcig brjod la/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pā na ya swā hā/ zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ sngar gyi shāntiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu a pā na ya bcug la/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad a pā na ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ kha'i chu de nyid phyi'i rgya mtshor dor bar mos la mdun du skyug tu gzhug go /srung ba ni/ spyi bo la sogs par rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la/ ngag tu tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa zhes pa nas/ klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa zhes pa'i bar brjod do// sngar gyi a pā na ya'i tshab tu rakṣa rakṣa bcug pa'o// slar yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bcom ldan rig pa'i rgyal mo'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /ces brjod do// de nas shis pa bya ba ni/ dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor bas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// zhes pa nas/ 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad gsum brjod/ de nas de dag gi skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod byas la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtang rag gi maṇḍal 'bul du bcug lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul snyam du bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni paṇa chen shākya shrī sogs nas brgyud pa'i tshe sbyin ma'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod byas la btang ngo*// de nas mjug gi bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis mdun gyi mchod pa rnams gong ltar bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re sogs kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ ces 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ badzra muḥs tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bstim/ rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung*/ bsngo ba dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod de spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// tshe sbyin ma'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang shin tu zab pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i gsung la zin bris su bkod pa 'di ni/ dge slong sangs rgyas rin chen gyis sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bum chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las ma// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ma// dran pa tsam gyis gdung sel ma// rje btsun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga dang*// bum chog rjes gnang cho ga rnams// rje btsun ma la mos pa'i blos// gzhan la phan phyir bshad kyis nyon// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas/

mdun du rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbu la bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam par bzhugs pa/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mastā rā ye/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sa twe bhyaḥ oṃ tā rā sarba buddha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ badzra puṣpāe āḥhūm̐/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tām̐ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis utpal dkar po thugs kar bsnams pa dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i ngang tshul can/ dbu skra mthon mthing ltar gnag pa ltag par bcings pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing*/ thugs kar zla ba la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba la tām̐ yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i tām̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ gong ltar mchod la/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tuttā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res nad rnams kun las sgrol// sgrol ma la yang phyag 'tshal lo// padma dkar po'i dbus gnas shing*// zla ba'i gzugs kyi gdan steng du// rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas mdzad ma// mchog sbyin ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ston ka'i zla ba'i mdangs 'dra zhing*// zla ba la ni rgyab brten ma// rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// utpal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu drug lo lon lus dang ldan// rdzogs sangs rgyas kun de yi sras// 'dod sbyin sku ni 'chang ba'i yum// 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo dkar po 'od zer dkar// rtsibs brgyad la ni yi ge brgyad// yongs su bskor ba'i rnam pa can// 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i lte bar tām̐ yig gi mthar oṃ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig hā zhes pas bskor ba dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun nas g.yas skor gyis/ tā re tuttā re tu re swā zhes pa las 'od 'phros/ rang gi lus thams cad gang*/

sdig sgrib dang dus min gyi 'chi ba thams cad dag sangs rgyas byang sems dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par yig 'bru rnams la thim par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ zhes ci mang dang*/ oṃ tā re tutta re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod de dge rtsa bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul na/ dkar gtor chu gtsang gis sbyangs la/ yo ga ltar byin gyis brlab mi shes na/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ tā re tuttā re sogs kyi mthar/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab gong ltar bya'o// ༈ /bum chog byed na/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lag len bzhin bsham/ yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las bum pa spyi dang mthun par bskyed/ de'i nang du pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig las rje btsun ma sngar ltar bskyed/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ ma lus sems can sogs shlo ka gsum gyis spyan drang*/ byon legs bya/ yon chab khrus chab gdan gsum phul/ mchod de oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥl sogs pas dgug gzhug bya/ dbang bskur rgyas btab dang*/ mchod bstod gong ltar byas la/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal btab/ 'khor lo dang sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/

gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ yi ge bcu pa mang du bzla/ gtor ma yod na gtang*/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dung chos kyi chu phul te lha zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam// ༈ /khrus chog byed na/ lha'i mtshan dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs rnam 'joms bzhin bya'o// ༈ /rjes gnang byed na/ slob dpon bsnyen pa song bas/ yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la/ gnas dben par maṇḍal khru gang pa la padma 'dab brgyad bri/ dbus su tshom bu dgod/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod 'das gtor dang cha gsum gtor ma/ bum pa rdo rje dril bu sogs bsham/ mchod pa yo ga ltar byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ tshom bu bsang sbyang sngon du 'gro ba'i bum bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bskyed/ mchod bstod bya/ bum pa gong ltar bsgrub/ gtor ma gtang*/ yi ge bcu pa stong phrag gcig bzla/ slob ma khrus byas te 'khod la/ maṇḍal phul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs shlo ka gcig dang 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma gong ltar lhar bskyed/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo gsal gdab/ slob dpon rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ bdag gi dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsal nas rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma thugs ka'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/

thog mar slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku dang thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las/ rje btsun ma'i sku dang thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon te/ slob ma rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku dang*/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa la thim pas rje btsun ma yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad slob ma'i rgyud la zhugs shing*/ 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer 'phros te/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas slob ma'i tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par du dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i las sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs par mos te yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥzhes yang yang bzlas shing rol mo bya/ dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang ba bsnams te dbang bskur bar mos te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i mthar/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par mos la mchod pa lngas mchod/ me tog gtor te bkra shis brjod/ sku'i rjes gnang thob cing sogs spyi dang mthun par ngo sprad/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/

slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i yig 'bru rnams la thim pas sngags kyi nus pa rgyas shing byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs par mos te/ yi ge bcu pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rjes zlos bya/ dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par byas par mos la/ slob dpon la me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis kyang slob ma'i mgo bor me tog bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs 'don pa bsgyur/ gsung gi rjes gnang thob ces sogs ngo sprad/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de'i thugs ka nas thugs ka'i 'khor lo sngags kyi yig 'bru dang bcas pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon te/ slob ma'i thugs kar thim par mos te/ lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang tsam ma 'gags shing*/ gshis lugs yod med ci'ang ma grub pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug bcom ldan 'das ma'i byin rlabs ni sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ thugs kyi rjes gnang thob ces sogs ngo sprad/ bkru byabs srung gsum byed na skabs 'dir bya/ rjes gtso bos maṇḍal deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun/ mchod pa kha gsos pa byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ lhag chad bskangs la/ bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badzra muḥtshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// bcom ldan 'chi med sgrol ma sgrub pa'i thabs// bum chog rjes gnang cho gar bcas pa 'di// shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis// sbyar ba'i dge bas sgrol ma nyid gyur cig /rjes gnang thun mong ba tsam byed na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'am/

rgya mtsho'i chings gang rung gis bya'o// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zur 'debs bzhugs so// rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo'i cho ga la/ ngag 'don rnams rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha gzhir bzhag de la rnal 'byor pa mang po tshogs pa'i cho ga byed tshe/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyi yig cha dang*/ mthong brgyud kyi phyag len tho la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i skabs su gnas khang byi dor byas par/ 'byor na mchog gsum spyi dang khyad par rje btsun ma'i bris 'bur gyi sku rten sogs dar zab sogs kyi na bza' dang bcas bkod pa mdzes par bsham pa dang*/ bla bre yol ba sogs kyi mchod rdzas kyang gang 'byor bsham/ de rnams gtan nas ma 'byor na chad pa'i skyon ni med do// de lta bu'i rten gyi drung du maṇḍal khru gang pa padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su tshom bu dkar po bkod pa bsham/ de'i byang shar du mtshams 'dzin me tog nas bzung ste chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams g.yas skor du bsham/ byang shar nas shar lho'i bar du zlum gtor gsum dang bgegs gtor rnams lag len bzhin bsham/ dmigs bsal ni/ gtor ma dang po 'das gtor te yi dam sgrol ma la yin/ gnyis pa phyogs skyong*/ gsum pa 'byung po/ bzhi pa bgegs gtor ni bgegs rigs la ster rgyu'o// slob dpon gyi mdun du cog tse sogs ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs la/ bum pa kha rgyan gzungs rdor gos zung rdor dril me tog sogs dang*/ rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyi mdun du'ang rdor dril dang gos zung dang rnga sil dung sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor bsham mo// dngos gzhi ni/ rten gyi gang zag 'di'i rjes gnang thob cing bsnyen pa song bas sha chang sgog btsong sogs spang zhing khrus sogs gtsang sbra dang bcas gdan la 'khod de/ nges 'byung gi blo dang gzhan phan byang sems sngon du btang nas/

sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams dang bcas mchod rdzas yakṣas bsang ba nas bzung ste mchod pa byin rlabs dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas byin dbab/ bdag bskyed ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste mjug gi mchod bstod gsol btab kyi bar dkyus bzhin la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhes brjod do// mdun bskyed maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma sogs nas sa mā dzaḥ'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba tsam ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ de nas spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems mgon ma dang spro na/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug sogs dang*/ de nas bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs nas/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyi bar dang*/ puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha sogs kyis dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i sogs nas 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa'i bar bya/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ dharmā ra ṇi brjod mi dgos/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho'am/ mchod yon phal cher ma gang rung dang*/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs nas sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa'i bar rgyal srid sna bdun dang 'dod yon lnga rnams yo ga ltar dbul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas bstod pa 'khor ba las sgrol sogs dang*/ gzhan yang rgya gzhung bod gzhung gang shes rnams kyis bstod/ bum pa bsang sbyang sogs dkyus bzhin la 'khor lo gsal btab nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ 'khor lo dang sku las sogs 'dra/ gtor ma rnams chab kyis bran te bsang sbyang*/ dang po yi dam sgrol ma la 'bul/ gzhan rnams cha gsum gyi cho gas gtang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar 'khor lo gsal btab ste/ bzlas pa stong phrag sogs bya/ spro na bzlas pa'i mjug tu'ang mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab bya/

khrus chog byed na lha'i mtshan dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs tshe dpag med dang rnam 'joms gang rung ltar bya/ rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlab pa sogs dkyus ltar la/ zhag grangs mang por byed na nyi ma snga ma rnams la rdul tshon la brtan bzhugs dang*/ rjes ma'i nyin gshegs gsol bya/ mjug tu bkra shis ston mchog dam pa'am che ba'i che mchog sogs rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam brgyud 'debs sogs bya zhing 'khor gsum rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab bo// 'di ni cung zad rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bsdu na mdun bskyed bum pa la bsdu ba dkyus bzhin no// buddha lakṣ+mīs e waṃ dharmā na du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /sgrol ma dkar mo'i bstod pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs bzhugs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo la gsol ba 'debs pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// ka ma la dang ku mud gnyen gyi steng*// kha ba dung ltar rab dkar lha mo'i sku// ga shal nor bu'i phreng bas rab mdzes ma// nga yi yi dam sgrol ma thugs rje can// ca co spangs pa'i rtse gcig bsam gtan gyis// cha lugs rab mdzes khyod sku rab bsgom zhing*// ja sogs 'dod yon phud kyis gus mchod kyi// nya gang zla 'dra'i zhal ras bstan du gsol// ta thā ga ta sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum// tha mal skye bos bsam pa'i yul min ma// da lta khyod min bdag la skyabs med pas// na chung khyod kyi zhal 'dzum bstan tu gsol// pa lā sha ltar 'jam pa'i phyag zhabs mthil// pha rol gzigs pa'i spyan gyis nyer mdzes shing*// ba mchog rdzi mas spras pa'i spyan bdun gyis// ma lus 'gro la kun tu gzigs su gsol// tsa na ka sogs srid kyi gzhung lugs dang*// tsha grang nad sel gso rig bstan bcos sogs// dza yas bsngags pa'i phyi nang rig gnas la// wa skyes ltar zhum bdag la bskyab tu gsol// zha nye ma 'dres dngul ltar dngas pa'i sku// za 'og reg 'jam gos kyis mdzes byas shing*// 'a thur snyan sgrog rked skabs dril chung gis// ya mtshan lus mdzes khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// ra ma ṇa ltar tshangs sogs 'jig rten gyis// la la min par rtag tu mi brdzi ba'i// sha rī ram gyi rdo rje legs thob nas// sa mu dra ltar phun tshogs rgyas par mdzod// ha ra gzung 'dzin 'phrog pa'i ye shes dang*// a yig skye med don mtshon de bzhin nyid// tha dad gnyis min zung 'jug chos kyi sku// ma ma khyod kyi drin las rtogs par shog

/sgrub la mchog ster 'khor ba las sgrol ma// thugs rje myur ma 'jigs pa brgyad sgrol ma// shin tu dpa' mo nad kun las sgrol ma// bdag gi nyer 'tshe bral ba'i gzhi tshugs mdzod// bdag la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub dang*// dpag yas bsod nams mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs// rnam dkar yon tan ma lus rgyas pa dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs su 'gyur bar mdzod// sa bdag rgyal po dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs// chos dang dpal 'byor ldan pa'i 'gro ba dang*// gdug cing ngan sems 'chang ba'i skye bo rnams// thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzod// mdor na bdag la tshe rabs thams cad du// 'phags ma khyod kyi thugs rjes rab bzung nas// tshul khrims ldan cing thos bsam 'phel ba dang*// srid zhi'i 'byor pa kun gyis brgyan par mdzod// khyed kyi thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang*// rten 'brel zab mo bslu ba med pa'i mthus// yi dam khyod kyis rjes su dgongs par shog /nā ma i daṃ kun 'dzin lo// gro bzhin pūrṇa mā sa'i tshe// bhikṣu dkon mchog lhun grub kyis// e wam̐ gnas su li khi taṃ// ༈ /rje btsun ma la 'dod don zhu ba'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// phrin las rang bzhin lha mo khyod bstod pas// seng ge glang chen me dang rkun po dgra// gdug pa'i sbrul dang btson khang chu bo'i 'jigs// mi bzad 'byung po'i gdon las bskyab tu gsol// glo bur 'chi dang rims nad drag po dang*// byad dang 'byung bzhi'i rkyen dbang mi 'gro bar// tshe ring bde bar gnas nas lam bsgrub par// phrin las lha mo khyod la gsol ba 'debs// srid gsum sdug bsngal me yi nang 'dug nas// shin tu brnag dka'i gdung bas bsregs lags na// byang sems ri bong 'dzin pa'i chu rgyun gyis// nyes pa'i nad 'di sel bar mdzad du gsol// chags dang 'jig lta 'dam rdzab 'dis bsgos nas// gnas lugs rin chen mthong bar ma gyur na// khyod thugs gaṅgā'i chu rgyun dri med kyis// yang dag ye shes snang ba bskyed du gsol// thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i sa lam gyis// theg pa'i mchog la rim gyis legs bgrod cing*// kun mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang mthon po nas// sdug bsngal ldan pa'i 'gro la gzigs par shog
/ces pa bsod

glo bo mkhan chen/ nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug zas gtsang shākya'i sras// thugs rje'i dbang phyug rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhabs// mkhas pa'i dbang phyug paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// btsun pa'i mchog gyur 'dul 'dzin byang chub dpal// mkhas grub dbang po mkhan chen bde ba dpal// shes bya kun mkhyen grags pa gzhon nu'i zhabs// gsol ba= /rin chen byang chub sems ldan bsod nams grags// 'jam dbyangs sprul sku bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// snyan brgyud gdams pas rgyud phyug dpal ldan pa// gsol ba= /mkhas btsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs shar chen rje// rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa e waṃ pa// skye dgu'i skyabs gcig dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /gnas lnga mthar phyin dam chos rin chen dpal// zab yangs blo gros rgya mtsho chos kyi rje// thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i rin bzang la// gsol ba= /rgyas ba'i sras po sngags 'chang sa skya pa// gsang sngags 'chang ba dkon mchog legs 'dzin rje// mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan don grub la// gsol ba= /sems dpa' chen po dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul chos kyi rje// bka' drin mnyam med sangs rgyas phun tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// rgyal ba'i yum mchog yid bzhin 'khor lo la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// nyes pa'i mun pa mtha' dag bsal byas te// ya mtshan sku mchog yid la dran pa dang*// khyod gsung dam chos sgra dbyangs sgrogs par bskul// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// 'dod chags chang gis rnam par myos gyur nas// zhe sdang me lce'i phreng bas rang gzhan bsregs// gti mug mun pas blang dor 'chol gyur pa'i// dug gsum 'byung po'i gdon las bskyab tu gsol// ngan song 'khor ba'i bde la ma chags shing*// myang 'das dman pa'i sems kyang rab spangs nas// gzhan phyir sangs rgyas thob 'dod smon pa'i sems// rtag tu dge la brtson par byin gyis rlobs// sna tshogs skye ba'i rba rlabs 'khrugs gyur cing*// mi bzad sdug bsngal rlabs kyis rnam par g.yengs// na rga 'chi ba'i chu srin rgyu ba'i gnas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// thugs rje'i 'od kyi phreng bas phyogs su khyab// snying rje'i gzhan don sprul sku 'jig rten mgon// sdug bsngal srid mtsho skem pa'i nyi ma che// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer 'gas bskul ngor da ri drā maṅga la'i ming can gyis bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud kyi dgra las rnam par rgyal nas yid bzhin 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig gong gi brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong ni/ sems dpa' chen po dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// zhes pa'i mtshams/ 'jam mgon bla ma sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// rnam 'dren mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med= /mkhas shing grub brnyes nam mkha' bsam 'grub dpal// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos kun dga' blo gros zhabs// thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha' 'chi med la// gsol ba 'debs so= /byams pa'i thugs rjes 'gro kun bu bzhin skyong*// lhar bcas dga' mdzad bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dpal// bka' drin mnyam med mkhan chen bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i sogs dang sbrel lo// ༈ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul yi ge'i zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dkar mdzes dar bab nam mkha'i rna ba yis// nyi bu'i dpung las rnam rgyal go 'phang nyid// sbyin pa'i mthu chen thob na gang sku yi// mtshungs dper bsngags so yid bzhin 'khor lo ma// gang gi sgrub thabs ngag dbang grags pa yi// 'chi bdag slu ba'i rtog pa las byung ba'i// gzhung don ji bzhin mkhas pa'i zhal lung bsten// tshe sbyin sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa bya tshul 'bri// de'ang 'dir sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi khyad chos mi 'dra ba mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas bsnyen pa byed pa la/

sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni gnas dben par byi dor byas la/ 'byor na rje btsun ma'i sku rten bris 'bur gang rung bkram pa'i mdun du/ yi dam sgrol ma la gtor ma cog zlum gcig sgrol ma'i bka' sdod kṣe tra pā la dang 'jigs byed chen mo gnyis la 'bul bar spro na thun mong du cog zlum gcig bya/ cha gsum gtor ma btang bar grub na'ang de'i gtor ma dang*/ gzhan nyer spyod bsham pa sogs spyi ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la gsum ste skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ tshogs bsags pa'o// dang po skyabs 'gro la/ rgyu yul tshul sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya ba las 'dir 'bri mi dgos mod/ de'i nang nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal 'debs pa'i tshul cung zad smos na/ rang nyid gnas pa'i zhing 'dir ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i sa gzhi baiḍūrya'i rang bzhin can gyi dbus su rang nyid gnas pa'i mdun gyi bar snang la rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam pa can la/ brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gsal 'debs pa'am/ yang na mdun gyi sa gzhi las yar skyes pa'i tshul gyi dpag bsam gyi yal ga lo ma me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rtse mor padma 'dab ma bzhi pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i lte bar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba thams cad kyang sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam pa can dang*/ mdun gyi 'dab mar sgrol dkar sogs yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ g.yas kyi 'dab mar longs sprul gyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas/ rgyab kyi 'dab mar lung rtogs chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam brtsegs pa/ g.yon gyi 'dab mar byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang nyan thos dgra bcom gyi tshogs/ gzhan yang chos srung nor lha rnams kyang mtha' skor dpag bsam shing gi lo 'dab kun tu bzhugs par gsal gdab/

skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang skyabs yul rang la bstim pa sogs spyi ltar ro// gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ dkyus kyi tshig de nyid ngag tu brjod cing sems can gyi don du rang nyid sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ni smon pa'i sems dang de'i ched du sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgom bzlas la 'bad pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed pa yin no// gsum pa tshogs gsag pa la gnyis/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs so// dang po ni/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa de la phyag bya ba dang mchod pa 'bul ba/ de dag gi spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba rnams sgrub thabs dkyus su gsal ba ltar don yid la dran pa'i sgo nas 'don pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gtan la phab nas de'ang nam mkha' la sprin yal ba ltar mi dmigs par bsam pa nyid do// de rnams ni sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste lha bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ sbyin bdag gi ched du dmigs bsal bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ sngar gyi stong nyid de'i ngang las rang sems gsal ba'i gdangs 'gags med yi ge pam̐ du gyur pa/ de las padma dkar po 'dab ma rgyas pa lte ba ge sar dang bcas par bsam/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams pa'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo tām̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas nas 'od zer tshur 'dus tām̐ bod yig dbu can gyi rnam pa la/ ring cha zla tshes la thig le nā da dang bcas par bsam/ yig la thim zhing*/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal btab pa ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag gnas gsum du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo 'bru gsum bsgoms pa ni byin gyis rlob pa nyer sgrub kyi yan lag

snying ga'i tām̐ gyi 'od zer gyis rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbyer med du bya ba dang gdan 'bul ba dang bcas pa ni sgrub pa'i yan lag dbang lha rigs lnga 'od dpag med gtso bor byas pa spyan drangs/ de la gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyi rgyas 'debs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag ste/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs nas/ de la rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams kyis/ tshur rang la mchod pa'i bsam pas mchod bstod bya ba rnams dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba ni lha bskyed cing mchod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ bzlas pa la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ yig dkar po langs thabs su gnas pa'i mthar/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes pa'am/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa gang yang rung bas bskor ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol tām̐ gyi mdun phyogs su oṃ dang rgyab phyogs su hā/ rtsibs brgyad la mdun rtsibs nas brtsams te/ yi ge re re ste brgyad dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa las 'od zer ston zla'i 'od ltar 'phros/ rang gi lus thams cad du khyab pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas gzhan gyi srog bcad pa la sogs pa tshe thung bar 'gyur pa'i sdig sgrib gang bsags bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par bsams la sngags kyi bzlas pa snying po yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu dang*/

de nyid tshe sgrub sngags dang sbrel ba'ang ci nus bzla/ tshe sgrub rgyas par bsags na 'bum phrag bzhi'i bsnyen pa bya ba yin no// gzhung dngos las ni/ ched du zla ba drug gi bar/ sgrol ma'i 'khor lo bsgoms byas pas// dngos grub thams cad thob 'gyur zhing*// 'chi ba'i skyon gyis mi gos so// zhes dang*/ zla ba drug tu tshang yid kyis// nges pa brtan po dag tu bya// yi ge bcu pa'i sngags 'di ni// mi skyo yid kyis bzla byar bya// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar na yi ge bcu pa zla ba drug tu bzla ba'ang gsungs pa'i dus kyi bsnyen pa'o// de ltar bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas sbyin sreg byed na mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa la sogs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge ltar bya ba yin no// gsum pa ni/ bsnyen pa de sbyin bdag gi ched du dmigs bsal dgos pa'i tshe/ dang po lha bskyed gzhi'i sa bon tām̐ yig bsgom pa de'ang rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i sems nyid kyi ngo bo yin snyam pa dang*/ de las 'od zer spro bsdu byas pa las byung ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sku bsgom pa de'ang ngo bo rang dang sbyin bdag dbyer med kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa lha sku sgrol ma dkar mo'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa ste/ de'ang ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa snang tsam rang bzhin stong pa nyid du bsgom pa yin la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe thugs kar zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐ dkar po'i khog pa sbubs stong yod pa'i nang du rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i gzugs brnyan ji lta ba re yod par gsal btab na/ tām̐ yig de rang dang sbyin bdag dbyer med du bsgoms par 'gro bas yi ge bcu pa bzla ba dang*/ tshe sgrub sngags sham bu can yang*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṇye dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes pa ste de bod skad du bsgyur na/ bdag gi tshe bsod nams ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa'i don yin pas rang dang sbyin bdag gnyis ka'i tshe bsod nams sogs rgyas pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yin/

sngar gyi dmigs pa'i gnad de dag ma shes na/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags dang*/ rang gi bzla bar bya ba'i sngags kyang sbyin bdag che ge mo gang dang gang yin gyi ming de dang de'i kha bsgyur rgya skad bod skad bsgyur shes pa zhig gis min pa su yin gyis bsnyen pa byed shes pa yang ma mngon no// thugs ka'i 'khor lo'ang phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtsa ba dang rtsibs kyi phyi rol du mu khyud dkar po rim gcig yod pa tsam gyis chog go /de las gzhan ma bshad pas mi dgos la/ 'khor lo'i lte bar tām̐ gyi mdun nas brtsams te nang skor du bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes rgyas par mdzod cig ces pas sgor mor 'khor bar yig 'bru langs thabs su yod par bsam/ yang de nyid legs sbyar gyi skad du rang gi ngag nas 'don bzhin byed par spro na/ ma ma ā yuḥpuṇya dzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru zhes pas bskor bar bsams kyang chog gnyis ka ltar yang de'i phyi rol gyi mdun phyogs su oṃ dang rgyab phyogs su hā yod pa bsgom pa yin no// rtsibs brgyad la mdun phyogs shar rtsibs la tā/ shar lhor re/ lhor tutā/ lho nub tu tra/ lho nub tu tā/ nub tu re/ nub byang du tu/ byang du re/ byang shar du swā rnams bkod/ de tsam las mu khyud rnams la yi ge bkod pa lugs 'di la mi bzhed pas de bzhin bya rung ba min no// thun bsdu ba ni/ bzlas pa'i mjug mchod bstod byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// de ltar rang don dang gzhan don gang gtso bor byed pa'i bsnyen pa gang yin yang de mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dang po rje btsun ma la sgrub thabs kyi dkyus ltar phul nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa sgrol ma'i bka' sdod kṣe tra pa la dang 'jigs byed chen mo la 'bul te/ 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs nas/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

bka' sdod kṣe tra pā la zhes bya ba mi dkar dar gyi thod bcings can gos dkar gyon pa/ chos skyong 'jigs byed chen mo zhes bya ba bud med sngo bsangs dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rnam pa can gnyis/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas gtor ma 'bul ba dgyes pas bzhes par bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ ma hā kṣe tra pā lā ya i daṃ ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis zhing skyong chen po la dbul/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ḍā ki ṇī ma hā bhai ra wyai i daṃ ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed chen mo la dbul/ de nas oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs nas/ nai wi dya āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ sngon tshe rje btsun sgrol ma'i spyan snga ru// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro la phan gdags shing*// gang bcol phrin las sgrub par dam bcas pa// zhing skyong 'jigs byed chen mo bcas la bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las bcol/ bka' sdod de gnyis ni bla ma gnyan lo tsā bas sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i dus su kṣe tra pā la 'ongs te/ nga sgrol ma'i bka' srung yin nga la gtor ma byin cig dang*/ ngas khyod sangs rgyas pa'i bar gyi yon bdag bya yis/ nga'i srog gi snying po 'bul gyi zhes smra zhing*/ oṃ kṣe tra pā la tsi ta ka yu bhe ra ta pa hūm̐ ha ho phaṭa swā hā zhes phul nas mi snang bar gyur to// de rjes tsam nas 'jigs byed chen mo 'ongs nas nga sgrol ma'i bka' sdod yin/ ngas khyod la srog gi snying po sbyin gyi/ bsnyen pa khri gyis la gtor ma byin cig ngas phrin las bzhi sgrub ces smra zhing*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī dzwa la tsi ta ke ra te ru bhā ya swā hā zhes dbul lo// srog snying 'di gnyis sngar gyi yi ge rnying pa'i rgyun 'byams song bas sngags dag po ma byung bas gtor ma 'bul ba la'ang mtshan sngags kyis chog par byas pa yin/

de min srog sngags gnyis dag pa zhig byung na de la gtor sngags btags nas 'bul na'ang chog go /de nas cha gsum gtor ma gtang ba'i dbang du song na cung zad ma gtogs kun rig ltar gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ mjug gi dbye ba dngos dang phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ mdun bskyed rje btsun ma la yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung ba dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis mdor bsdus kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni gzhung las/ tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i rtse mo bskyod mi nus// 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma bzhin// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan dang*// nad dang dbul sogs mdor bsdu na// seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// sdug bsngal tshogs rnams rab tu 'joms// zhes dang*/ dngos grub gzhan 'byung ba'ang de nyid las/ skul ba med par gos dang ni// kha zas rin chen la sogs thob// ral gri mig sman rkang mgyogs dang*// bum pa bzang po la sogs 'grub// snyan mngags dang ni smra ba mkhas// blo rno shes rab dri ma med// gzhan yang 'dod pa'i dngos grub rnams// 'khor lo 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams dang*/ gzhan yang 'di nyid ni phrin las kyi lha yin/ 'phags bod kyi mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mang pos bsgrubs pa dang gsol ba btab pas 'phral nyid du rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus yid ches skyed pa mang du mchis mod/

'dir yi ge mang gis dogs pas ma bris so// yang rje tshar chen yab sras nas brgyud pa 'od zer drug sbrags bsgom pa dang thugs ka'i 'khor lo sogs khyad par rgyas tsam 'byung ba yod mod/ de'i lugs kyi rjes gnang khrid bcas thob dgos pa yod do// 'dir smras pa/ yid 'phrog mdzes sku yid kyi rtsibs logs su// snang stong rtse gcig pir gyis legs bris nas// grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pas 'chi med tshe// sgrub thabs rmad byung sgrol ma zla bzhin ma// gang gi sgom bzlas la brten rgyal ba dang*// rgyal yum sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang*// byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad rang dbang du// 'gugs par byed pa'i bsnyen pa bya tshul bgyis// de las skyes pa'i legs byas zla 'od gsar// mtha' yas 'gro blo'i sa dga'i me tog tshal// reg pa'i mod la tshe dpal bsod nams kyi// 'dab brgya rnam grol byang chub tshogs rgyur shog /ces sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge'i zla 'od gsar pa zhes bya ba 'di/ rdzong chen mgo'i dbu mdzad bla ma phun tshogs grags pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi bsti gnas su bris pa sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ ༈ /na mo gu ru tā rā ye/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug ston pa shākya'i tog /rje btsun sgrol ma paṇa chen shākya shrī// mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// grags pa gzhon nu rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams grags pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen ye shes mtshan// ngor chen kun dga' bzang po mus chen rje// paṇa chen chos dpal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// blo gros rgya mtsho rin chen bzang po dang*// sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams dkon mchog legs// dpal ldan don grub dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la=

/bkra shis lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// bka' srol byin rlabs dngos brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras dang bcas// bstan srung nor sbyin rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma mchog gsum gtan gyi skyabs bzung nas// bslab bya'i sdom pa nyes med bsrung ba dang*// gzhan don bla med byang chub go 'phang nyid// smon 'jug sems kyi dam bca' brling bar shog /dad gsum snying rje'i yul la nyer brten nas// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs dang chos kun gyi// gnas lugs yang dag rtogs pa'i ye shes tshogs// zung 'jug sku gnyis 'grub rgyur smin par shog /chu skyes zla ba'i gdan la tām̐ yig gi /'phro 'du las grub yid bzhin 'khor lo ma'i// mdzes sku dar bab bsgoms pas dal 'byor rten// rga shi med par rdo rje'i sku thob shog /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtsho dang 'jigs chen brgyad// nad rims gdung ba las sgrol gsang ba'i sngags// grags stong rang bzhin med bzlas rgyal kun gyis// rjes bzung 'chi med dngos grub thob par shog /snying dbus zla ba'i 'khor lo yig 'bru las// 'od zer spro bsdus las sgrib kun sbyangs nas// 'khor 'das tshe bcud dbang bsdus bdag la thim// lus kun khyab pas 'chi med thob par shog /mdor na 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma yi// gsang gsum rnal 'byor sgom bzlas rten 'brel gyis// bdag gi sgo gsum rdo rje gsum grub nas// bstan dang sems can don chen 'byung bar shog /ces rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni/ dge slong bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// //gong gi brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i rjes su/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*// ngag gi dbang po kun dga' blo gros zhabs// mkhas shing grub pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi rgyan// nam mkha' 'chi med rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rigs kun khyab bdag kun dga'i mtshan can sogs// bka' srol byin rlabs sogs dang sprel lo//

༈ /rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// 'dod don kun 'grub sbyin sreg gi /lag len gsal bar bshad kyis nyon// 'dir sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i gang zag gis sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi rim gro sogs 'dod don bsgrub pa'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me// rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces pa ltar las dang po thab ni sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sa phyogs yin na gang du bya ba'i gnas su rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin btang la/ dang po gnyis kyi 'phrin bcol gyi rjes su/ sa phyogs 'dir 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang sems can gyi don bgyid par 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la gshegs gsol sogs bya/ bgegs gtor gyi rjes su sa'i phyogs 'dir sogs gong ltar las 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams/ gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis phyogs kun tu babs pas bgegs thams cad byer bar bsam pa ni sa bslang ba'o// de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs thams cad lag pas bcag la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin tu bsam/ de bzhin tu oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsam pa ni sa sbyang ba'o// de nas thab khung bur byed na rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed brko/ mchur sor bzhir skyed pa kha sgyer/ de nas mu ran dpangs su sor bzhi brtsigs pa'i khar padma'i phreng ba'am rdo rwa bya/ de'i phyi rol gru bzhi dkar por byas la grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje bya/ thab kyi phyi nang thams cad kha dog dkar po bya/ nang du padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar utpa la dkar po'am tshom bu sogs lha'i mtshan ma bya'o// bris thab byed na gzhi 'thas par byas la thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la khru phyed kyi dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi bskor ba kha sgyer dang*/ slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la thig bzhi'i rtse legs par sbrel ba'i stegs bu gru bzhi dang*/ de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha ga gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni bri cha mig sngar mdzes pa dang*/ bsgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba la padma'i lte ba dang phyi'i sum gnyis la padma'i 'dab ma bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar por bya/ kha sgyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng bas bskor/ bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skyas bya/ lte bar utpal dkar po'am tshon phung ngam me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ de'ang rje btsun ma'i zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu bstan pa'i mtshan ma 'god lugs sogs shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bud shing ni/ pa lā sha'am tsher ma can ma yin pa 'o ma can gyi shing sor

yam shing gi tshad kyang 'di nyid do/ brgyad pa yan chad khru gang tsam brtsig de ma 'byor na srog chags med pa'i ba lang sogs kyi lci bas thab kyi kha sgyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang bzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba me ni rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o// bzhi pa rdzas ni/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o// lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byug thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can sogs shar du phyogs par bya/ mdun du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang gzar blugs kha sbyar la bzhag dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa dang*/ grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa wam̐ yig dkar po bris pa'ang bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ rje btsun ma me lha phyogs skyong 'byung po gzhi bdag rnams la zlum gtor re re dang bgegs gtor rnams bsham/ g.yas su rang ngos nas brtsams te thab kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang*// 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma// gro dang dūrba ku sha rnams// lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham// ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar rnams stabs gang bder bzhag yo byad thams cad dri bzang gi chus gtor te bzhag go /drug pa sgrub pa po ni snga dro'i dus rang nyid khrus byas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i rjes su sngags kyi lhag chad kha skong zhing nus pa dbyung ba dang sdig pa dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan pos sngar bshams pa'i rten la kha shar du bltas te skyil krung ngam/

pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i tsog pu rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang*// thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod// 'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod bya ba'i bar thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha sogs lugs mthun gyi mngon rtogs bsgom/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo// gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te lag pa gnyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing yi ge bcu pa lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang*/

yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod la mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dzrīṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyang*/ oṃ bodhi pṛkṣā ya swā hā zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams kyis byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dngas shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang pa/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ thab kyi nang du bam̐ las me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes dkar po la chibs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa'am/ yang na phyag bzhi pa g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/

sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de'i thugs ka'i ram̐ dang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥzhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ agna ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sa dha ka ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza sa twāṃ/ gṛ hī twā a hu tiṃ ā ha ra/ a sminsa nni hi to bha ba/ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ zhes brjod la thab tu me tog cig phul te thab kyi shar lhor padma'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā zhes pas mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ badzra ā na la ma hā bhū ta dzwa la ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa dṛ shya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya st+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥl sogs pas dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod lnga ghaṇḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badzra satwa āḥzhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas bsang chu phyogs kun tu gtor te a mṛ ta'am yakṣa brjod pas bgegs bsal lo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsams te/ oṃ agna ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ agna ye ā dī byā dī bya ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya bahna ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod la yam shing la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams rim bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul lo// oṃ bodhi bṛkṣā ya swā hā/

yam shing*/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badzra bī dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badzra ghasma ryai swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzrā ya swā hā/ ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am yang na sngags de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs nas agna ye 'ba' zhig gis phul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa'i mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes las sngags kyi spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod do// de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang bstod pa sngar ltar byas te/ oṃ arghaṃ swā hās mchod yon dang*/ oṃ prokṣa ṇaṃ tītstsha swā hās bsang gtor phul la mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ badzra dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur bar bsam mo// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥ'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin las mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rang nyid ces pa'i tshab tu de nyid ces pa 'don pa bsgyur ro// de nas spro na spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs shlo ka gcig gis spyan drangs/

oṃ padma ka ma lā ya stāṃ gyis gdan phul la mchod pas mchod/ oṃ āryā tā re sa pa ri wā ra'i rjes su oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ badzra spo ṭa baṃ/ badzra ā be sha āḥzhes pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya/ de nas dbang lha spyan 'dren nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab bar bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ de'i mtha' skor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor bar gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chu gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs bar bsams pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā zhes lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ agna ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang ba mthar/ oṃ agna ye ā dī byā dī bya zhes sogs swā hā'i gong du bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul/ de nas yo ga ltar mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas rol mo'i bar dang spro na rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga rnams kun rig ltar ro// bstod pa ni/ oṃ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs nas/ 'khor lo can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ spro na 'dod don gsol btab ni/ phrin las rang bzhin lha mo khyod bstod pas// seng ge glang chen me dang rkun po dgra// gdug pa'i sbrul dang btson khang chu bo'i 'jigs// mi bzad 'byung po'i gdon las bskyab tu gsol// glo bur 'chi dang rims nad drag po dang*// byad dang 'byung bzhi'i rkyen dbang mi 'gro bar// tshe ring bde bar gnas nas lam sgrub par// phrin las lha mo khyod la gsol ba 'debs// srid gsum sdug bsngal me yi nang 'dug nas// shin tu brnag dka'i gdung bas bsregs lags na// byang sems ri bong 'dzin pa'i chu rgyun gyis// nyes pa'i nad 'di sel bar mdzad du gsol// chags dang 'jig lta 'dam rdzab 'dis bsgos nas// gnas lugs rin chen mthong bar ma gyur na// khyod thugs gaṅgā'i chu rgyun dri med kyis// yang dag ye shes snang ba bskyed du gsol// thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i sa lam gyis// theg pa'i mchog la rim gyis legs bgrod de// kun mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang mthon po nas// sdug bsngal ldan pa'i 'gro la gzigs par shog
/ces gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab bo// de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar bo dhi bṛkṣa la sogs pa'i

so so'i sngags gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa dbul/ rdzas thams cad yi ge bcu pa 'ba' zhig gis phul la logs nas sgrub g.yog cig gis grangs bzung*/ bsnyen pa kha gso la sogs pa'i dus su nub re la til stong phrag lnga'am khri la sogs pa ji tsam nus pa dbul zhing skabs skabs su yam shing dang mar ci 'byor pa phul/ sgrub g.yog cig gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang 'jug go /de la yam shing ni byang chub shing du mos la me 'od 'bar ba la/ til dang khu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha thams cad kyi zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ dūrba dang ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum phul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba rol mo'i bar dang bstod pa bya/ 'das pa'i gtor ma rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang*/ rdo rje me'i sngags rgyas sbyang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ a kā ros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas kyi ljags rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing snying po'i mthar ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas dbul/ mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ de nas phyogs skyong 'byung po rnams la cha gsum ltar dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma byin rlabs cha gsum ltar la lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs kyis bsngos nas/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don thams cad chos bzhin tu 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol zhes brjod/
