de nas bgegs la cha gsum ltar gtang ngo*// skabs 'dir lhag chad kha skong ba'i bsam pas yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs dang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang*/ rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyis se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes la/ me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang*// 'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad skong*// las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no// dang po me lha mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod de me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa phul/ mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ gnyis pa me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma gcig bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/

'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs// rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gandhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ gsum pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chad dang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad bsgyur te yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ mchod yon dang bsang gtor sngar bzhin phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ agna ye gatstsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo sogs kyi smon lam ci shes dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// drug pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan la reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la thal ba 'dod pa rnams la'ang sbyin zhing lhag ma 'bab chu la sogs par dor/

thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas rung ngo*// thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis bya'o// de ltar sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo yi// sbyin sreg 'di ni skyes chen gong ma yi// gsung gi nying khu bsdus pa'i legs bshad de// lag len rtogs sla 'dod don kun grub yin// 'on kyang bdag blo dman pa'i skyon chags pa'i// nyes tshogs mchis na 'phags pa'i tshogs la bshags// legs pa'i dge des bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dbang phyug myur thob shog /'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems kyi rdo rje'i ngo bo rje btsun bla ma dam pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ snyom las pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrīs mdzad pa'i yi ge dang*/ gzhan yang yi ge rnying pa du ma la gzhi byas bla ma mkhas pa'i phyag len gyis legs par brgyan nas shin tu myur bar bris pa dge legs 'phel// //'di ni lag len tsam gsal bar bkod pa yin la de'ang bsnyen pa kha skong la bsnyen sngags ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i grangs kyi til yi ge bcu pas 'bul ba yin no// gzhan tshe sgrub dang rim gro sogs la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gyi gsal kha ni 'dir yi ge mang gis dogs pas ma bris shing logs su 'chad par spro'o// ༈ /rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho bzhugs so// āryā tā rā yai na maḥ sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen pa dang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sngon du song nas/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas/ rang gzhan gyi rim gro tshe sgrub sogs kyi bsgyur dgos la/ hūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po dngas shing thogs pa med pa rgyar khru do pa/ dpangs su khru gang pa/ kha sgyer la rin po che dang utpa la'i phreng bas bskor ba phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/
